name: Creekmoor Golf Club
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Black, Green. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: holes 1, 8, 9, 10, 12, 16, 17: wrong routing; 2 more with a wrong tee or pick

1: Missing from the page: no tee was found. The green is OSM way/1489923972 (next to the hole-2 tees), but its tee (404 yds back on the card) is not identified; no OSM tee row fits.
3: Tees (OSM row running N-S along the cart path) and the green are plausible, but the straight line from tee to green crosses a subdivision: the hole must dogleg left (north, then west).
8: The Black tee is a lidar pad 74 yds from any OSM tee, and the line runs from beside the hole-7 tees to green way/1489923993 across a street and houses.
9: The line runs from a tee in the 8 tee row across a subdivision to green way/1489923973; the Green/White/Red tees are lidar pads 40+ yds from any OSM box. The real tee and green are uncertain.
10: The Black tee is a lidar pad 191 yds from any OSM tee and the Green tee is a 202-yd walk-back; the line crosses a cul-de-sac of houses. The tee is wrong, and the green (way/1490357740) is unconfirmed.
12: Missing from the page. Fix: OSM tee row way/1490361208..1212 (bearing 57) to green way/1490361213 gives 239/185/161/107 yds vs card 240/187/159/108, an exact fit.
13: Black is on OSM box way/1490361214 (549 vs 548), but Green/White/Red are lidar pads inside dense woods and the OSM row 1214-1217 runs N-S away from the green.
16: The tees are lidar pads among houses and the line crosses a whole subdivision to green way/1490350625. The OSM tee row at lon -94.4688 belongs to hole 17 (exact yardage fit).
17: Missing from the page. Fix: OSM tee row way/1490357722/23/24/26 (lon -94.4688, playing SSE) to green way/1490357729 gives 215/184/157/97 yds vs card 214/184/156/97, an exact fit.
